description: Trivia Zero is a bilingual flashcard trivia application for Flipper Zero. It shows random questions one at a time and reveals the answer when you press OK, with anti-repeat history so you don't see the same question twice in a row. The app ships with two embedded question packs (English and Spanish), no SD card copy required, and stores user settings persistently across sessions.
